title: New H-1B Fee Could Discourage Employers From Hiring International Graduates
summary_en: ​ACE and 18 other higher education associations are urging DHS to withdraw a proposed rule that would impose a $103,265 fee on H-1B petitions, warning that the extraordinary cost could make it harder for the US to attract and retain international talent.
title_cn: New H-1B Fee Could Discourage Employers From Hiring International Graduates

title: ACE, Higher Ed Groups Urge Education Department to Withdraw Proposed Grant Rule
summary_en: ACE and 39 higher education associations urge ED to withdraw proposed changes to its grant regulations, warning that the revisions would expand the department’s authority over federal grants and weaken merit-based review.
title_cn: ACE, Higher Ed Groups Urge Education Department to Withdraw Proposed Grant Rule
